name: GitUp
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow Tier A behavior for this primary application updater: GitUp embeds SUPublicEDKey in Info.plist; AppDelegate starts Sparkle and calls checkForUpdatesInBackground unless the disable preference is set.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in pinned key/configuration.
